def leak_test(features,s,t):
    spoiled=s.astype(float).copy()
    mask=spoiled.index>=t
    spoiled.loc[mask]=1000+np.arange(mask.sum())**2+np.arange(mask.sum())*17
    a=features(s).loc[t]
    b=features(spoiled).loc[t]
    changed=~(a.eq(b)|(a.isna()&b.isna()))
    return sorted(a.index[changed].tolist())
leaking=leak_test(features,s,pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15 12:00'))
